plate.narration: Rain sweeps across a temple island high above the realm. Wind banners stream over the wet landing. Through the clouds, another island appears for a moment, then fades behind the rain.

goal.text: Keep the temple safe as the returning island drifts toward it.

voiceGuide.tone: Warm, curious and practical. Short sentences. Show the consequence of each plan. Nobody dies.

arrival.narration: The island you helped welcome home is drifting toward a temple island through heavy rain. A different kitsune keeper from the one at the lookout rings a lookout bell; its rope wears a tiny raincoat. Beside the temple, a fresh opening spills bone crawlers onto the wet landing: little scuttling creatures with jointed legs and rattling backs. "Keep the temple safe as that island drifts toward us," the keeper calls. "We can push its approach clear, or shelter this landing and let it settle." She points to people still carrying cushions across the yard.

variants.text: Your earlier course warning reached this bell tower. The keepers have already moved the heavy furniture inside.
Your first message asked for another reader. The keepers were checking the old carving when the storm bell rang; furniture still waits in the yard.

look.narration: From behind the low fence, watch the drifting island edge against the fixed bell tower. Mark the clear sighting interval. The bell rope has a tiny raincoat and is taking the weather very seriously.

interaction.cue: Mark the island edge during the clear sighting.

onSuccess.narration: The keeper confirms the approaching edge from another window.

onFailure.narration: Rain hid your sighting. The keeper checks the nearer fence and tower before opening any lane.

onAssisted.narration: The keeper confirms the approaching edge from another window.

people.narration: Everyone needs a dry lane into the hall. Your earlier warning, if sent, has already moved the heavy furniture; otherwise the folded screen still blocks the doorway. Check the actual yard before doing another carrying job.

choices.label: Inspect and clear the remaining doorway load
Use the lane our warning already cleared

screen.narration: The screen balloons across the doorway. "It would like to come in first," says a keeper. Carry it flat, or tie and pass the bundle along the fence.

choices.label: Level the screen and carry it flat
Tie the screen and pass it inward

variants.text: Your warning already brought the heavy screen inside. Only a small cushion bundle remains at the doorway. Carry it flat, or tie and pass it along the fence. The top cushion is determined to be a hat.

people_check.narration: Level the screen while keepers guide the far edge through the doorway. The painted birds arrive beak-first.

interaction.cue: Level the doorway load before carrying it in.

onSuccess.narration: The remaining load reaches the hall and the doorway is clear.

onFailure.narration: The remaining load reaches the hall and the doorway is clear.

onAssisted.narration: The remaining load reaches the hall and the doorway is clear.

variants.text: Level the last cushion bundle while the keeper guides its far end through the doorway. The heavy screen is already inside, thanks to your warning.

screen_relay.narration: Pass the tied screen along the sheltered fence, keeping the people's lane clear.

interaction.cue: Pass the tied doorway bundle into the hall.

onSuccess.narration: The remaining load reaches the hall and the doorway is clear.

onFailure.narration: The remaining load reaches the hall and the doorway is clear.

onAssisted.narration: The remaining load reaches the hall and the doorway is clear.

variants.text: Pass the last small cushion bundle along the fence. The heavy screen is already inside; you are finishing the remaining light work.

ready_lane.narration: Check the yard together and help the last cushion carrier into the hall. Nobody stays outside to rescue a cushion. The keeper's very soft helmet comes inside too.

messages.narration: The last keeper reaches the covered hall. The temple has shelter for everyone, even the bell rope's spare raincoat. Your party can now work on the landing while the keepers signal from inside. The temple's own griffin messenger shelters at the back of the hall, ready to carry travelers down to the Cairnstep once the wind clears.

variants.text: The island letter courier whose sealed letters you saved offers to relay your signals from the hall.
The island letter courier is still finishing the delayed letter relay. A keeper takes the signal station until that courier arrives.

gear.narration: One team can prepare the long turning rope, shortening the push objective from three working turns to two, or fasten wind cover that removes the storm's Guard penalty from your party. The other job stays ordinary. Neither removes the crawlers or the crosswind tiles. Which advantage fits your plan?

choices.label: Prepare wind cover for the party
Have our thornguard brace the wind cover

gear_rope.narration: Guide the long rope loop through the working post from behind the fence. A missed alignment needs a shorter line, not another identical attempt. The keeper moves the marker to match its reach.

interaction.cue: Guide the rope loop through the post.

onSuccess.narration: The long turning line is ready: pushing can use two working turns.

onFailure.narration: The loop caught on the sock line. Set it aside and rig the shorter store rope; pushing will need three working turns.

onAssisted.narration: The keeper helps align the long loop. It is ready for the two-turn push job.

short_line.narration: Pass the shorter store rope to the nearer post while the keeper checks its reach. The socks stay completely outside the rescue plan.

interaction.cue: Pass the shorter line to the nearer post.

onSuccess.narration: The short line is checked. The ordinary three-turn push remains available.

onFailure.narration: The short line is checked. The ordinary three-turn push remains available.

onAssisted.narration: The short line is checked. The ordinary three-turn push remains available.

shelter_check.narration: Hold wind cover low along the landing while a keeper secures its ties. It protects party figures from the Guard penalty, not from crawlers or crosswind pushes. Solo heroes can use the fixed posts as supports.

interaction.cue: Support the wind cover while its edges are tied.

onSuccess.narration: The party's working lane has wind cover.

onFailure.narration: The party's working lane has wind cover.

onAssisted.narration: The party's working lane has wind cover.

shelter_braced.narration: Your thornguard uses a skill called Brace to keep the wind cover steady while the keepers secure it. That replaces the separate holding task. The other party members check the sight line; the turning rope remains ordinary.

signals.narration: The keeper raises a cloth for hold and lowers it for release. Watch her practice round before anyone takes the load. Shouted guesses would vanish into the squall.

interaction.cue: Watch the cloth round, then echo it.

onSuccess.narration: Your checked cloth round can be taught to the relief watch.

onFailure.narration: The keeper will lead the cloth calls. Your account names this as helped signal work.

onAssisted.narration: The keeper will lead the cloth calls. Your account names this as helped signal work.

rest.narration: Inside the covered hall, the keepers pass around a basket of rice buns. You rest on cushions rescued from the rain. One cushion has a solemn embroidered bird with a bun crumb on its beak.

choices.label: Eat while the keeper holds watch

plan.narration: The island's low edge comes alongside the posts. Choose the job your party will play on the board: turn it away, or hold the sheltered landing until it settles. Your preparation changes that encounter; it does not settle the island by itself.

choices.label: Hold shelter and let the island settle

push_plan.narration: You run the strong ropes through the mooring posts and leave room for them to slip free afterward. The keeper holds the release cloth ready. The plan is a small turn at the edge, not a tug across the sky.

choices.label: Work inside our prepared wind cover

fight_push.narration: End 3 turns beside the working post to turn the island clear, or clear the crawlers so the keepers can finish. The squall lowers everyone's Guard by one. Crosswind tiles still push figures west.

fight_push_rope.narration: End 2 turns beside the working post to turn the island clear, or clear the crawlers so the keepers can finish. The squall lowers everyone's Guard by one. Crosswind tiles still push figures west.

fight_push_cover.narration: End 3 turns beside the working post to turn the island clear, or clear the crawlers so the keepers can finish. Your wind cover removes the party Guard penalty; enemies still lose one Guard. Crosswind tiles still push figures west.

shelter_plan.narration: You draw the sheltered corner tight and leave a clear place for the island's low edge to rest. The keeper marks a boundary the temple cushions must never cross, even after the storm.

choices.label: Work inside our prepared wind cover

fight_shelter.narration: Hold the sheltered landing for two clear rounds, or clear the crawlers so the keepers can finish holding it. The squall lowers everyone's Guard by one. Crosswind tiles still push figures west.

fight_shelter_rope.narration: Hold the sheltered landing for two clear rounds, or clear the crawlers so the keepers can finish holding it. The squall lowers everyone's Guard by one. Crosswind tiles still push figures west.

fight_shelter_cover.narration: Hold the sheltered landing for two clear rounds, or clear the crawlers so the keepers can finish holding it. Your wind cover removes the party Guard penalty; enemies still lose one Guard. Crosswind tiles still push figures west.

pushed.narration: The island's low edge turns past the posts. The keepers finish the pull from their sheltered side and release the line. The island drifts clear of the temple, leaving only a trail of rain from its grass. The keeper lowers the cloth and sits on a cushion immediately.

settled.narration: The low island edge settles beside the sheltered landing. Your cover holds. The keepers close the outer gate to mark where temple ends and new ground begins. Someone hangs a polite notice on the gate: PLEASE KNOCK, EVEN IF YOU ARE AN ISLAND.

damaged.narration: The crawlers force your party back behind the gate. The keepers pull the shelter shut and help you recover inside. The island bumps the empty landing. Boards crack and the outer awning folds; everyone is already under the stone roof. The outer landing must stay closed tonight. The morning crew will need your spare gear to repair it.

boards_check.narration: Sight the near boards from the stone threshold. Rain may hide a shifted edge. A damaged outer landing remains closed even if you make a clear observation now.

interaction.cue: Mark the near board edge during a clear view.

onSuccess.narration: The keeper marks only checked ground. Damage stays marked for repair.

onFailure.narration: The keeper closes the outer boards and keeps work at the stone threshold.

onAssisted.narration: The keeper checks the near board edge with you. The record names the helped inspection.

roof.narration: Drips are finding every dry cushion. Clear the leaf wad with the long pole from inside the fence, or level a basin under the loose gutter end. Both jobs stay below the roof and behind the checked edge.

choices.label: Guide the pole to the leaf wad

roof_pole.narration: Guide the pole tip to the leaf wad from the sheltered side. The keeper braces the pole's rest. A good plop is the only applause required.

interaction.cue: Guide the pole tip inside the leaf-wad interval.

onSuccess.narration: The leaf wad plops into a bucket and runoff clears the doorway.

onFailure.narration: The first splash reaches the threshold. Use a mat and broom to redirect it instead of repeating the poke.

onAssisted.narration: The leaf wad plops into a bucket and runoff clears the doorway.

roof_basin.narration: Level the basin under the lowered gutter end. The keeper holds the gutter from inside the window. No one climbs onto the wet roof.

onSuccess.narration: The basin sends runoff away from the doorway.

onFailure.narration: The basin sends runoff away from the doorway.

onAssisted.narration: The basin sends runoff away from the doorway.

runoff_help.narration: Pass the dry-side broom and rolled threshold mat to the keeper. Sweep the first puddle out while the gutter drains into the basin.

interaction.cue: Pass the threshold kit from the dry side.

onSuccess.narration: The small puddle is cleared. The outer boards keep their actual repair marks.

onFailure.narration: The small puddle is cleared. The outer boards keep their actual repair marks.

onAssisted.narration: The small puddle is cleared. The outer boards keep their actual repair marks.

repair.narration: The next crew needs a real handover. You may leave your spare boards and line with the keeper, or recover the unused kit from checked ground. Your boundary marks stay in place either way.

choices.label: Leave the spare kit for the morning crew
Recover unused kit from checked ground

variants.text: The outer landing is broken and stays closed tonight. The morning crew needs your spare boards and line for repairs. Pass that kit into the temple store from behind the safe boundary; it must stay here when your party leaves.

repair_1.narration: Pass the spare boards and line to the keeper from behind the safe boundary. This is a kit left with the temple; it will not quietly reappear in the ending.

interaction.cue: Pass the repair kit to the morning crew's store.

onSuccess.narration: The spare kit stays with the temple crew.

onFailure.narration: The spare kit stays with the temple crew.

onAssisted.narration: The spare kit stays with the temple crew.

repair_2.narration: Support the spare kit while the keeper releases its storage ties from checked ground. Your party can take this unused kit; any damaged boards remain the temple's repair job.

onSuccess.narration: The unused spare kit returns to your party.

onFailure.narration: The unused spare kit returns to your party.

onAssisted.narration: The unused spare kit returns to your party.

record.narration: The keeper opens the log beside the old island songs. "Tomorrow needs the real landing," she says, moving the book away from a determined raindrop. Make a signal account for a cloth drill, or a boundary map for a sight-line drill.

choices.label: Record the signal work for the next watch

record_signals.narration: You and the keeper record the preparation, board work and actual result. She adds the island's present position and any damaged outer landing. Checked cloth calls go on the page; places where a keeper led remain marked as helped work. Rain ticks against the hall window.

variants.text: The first cloth round was recalled by your party; the log can say so.
The first cloth round was keeper-led. The log credits that help even if your later drill goes well.

record_map.narration: Trace the checked boundary, leaving unchecked boards blank. The keeper labels the island's actual position and any broken landing.

interaction.cue: Mark only the checked boundary interval.

onSuccess.narration: The map distinguishes checked ground from the unchecked edge.

onFailure.narration: The keeper marks the broad safe threshold and leaves fine board detail unclaimed.

onAssisted.narration: The map distinguishes checked ground from the unchecked edge.

watch.narration: A boundary observation station is always useful. If you chose a signal account, you can instead use it to lead the cloth drill. Choose the job you will actually show the next watch.

choices.label: Show a fixed boundary observation station
Teach the cloth drill from our signal account

watch_signals.narration: Watch the keeper demonstrate hold, hold, release, hold. Echo it for the relief watch. If you need help, the keeper leads; nobody hands a guessed signal round to the next crew.

interaction.cue: Echo the keeper's relief-watch cloth round.

onSuccess.narration: The relief watch has practiced the checked round.

onFailure.narration: The keeper will lead a visible demonstration rather than pass along a guessed round.

onAssisted.narration: The keeper will lead a visible demonstration rather than pass along a guessed round.

watch_help.narration: Help the keeper demonstrate the actual hold and release calls. The relief watch can see her cloth and practice without a loaded rope.

watch_map.narration: Use the fixed fence post and tower edge to mark a change from shelter. Only the view is checked; the party does not step onto the outer boards.

interaction.cue: Compare the edge during the clear sight-line interval.

onSuccess.narration: The relief watch can observe from checked ground.

onFailure.narration: Rain hid the edge. Set a nearer watch station at the stone threshold.

onAssisted.narration: The relief watch can observe from checked ground.

watch_map_help.narration: Pass a bright marker to the keeper at the stone threshold. The relief watch will use her nearer fixed view, not a guessed distant line.

interaction.cue: Pass the near-station marker to the keeper.

onSuccess.narration: A nearer watch station is ready behind the closed edge.

onFailure.narration: A nearer watch station is ready behind the closed edge.

onAssisted.narration: A nearer watch station is ready behind the closed edge.

ending.narration: The temple is safe to shelter in, and every keeper has a dry place. The bell rope sheds its tiny raincoat into a bucket. A griffin messenger can carry you down to the Cairnstep when the wind clears; the path behind returns to the island's lookout. You have changed what the next watch will find. As the squall eases, the fresh opening shrinks shut. The keepers watch from behind a striped wait sign until its last shimmer is gone; no new crawlers can enter the hall.

variants.text: The landing stays closed for repairs. Your account records the lost boards and the shelter that kept everyone safe.
The returned island now rests beside the temple. The keepers will watch the new boundary instead of pretending the two islands always lay together.
Your spare boards and line stay with the morning crew. Your party leaves without that local repair kit.
Your unused spare kit is packed with your party; the temple keeps its checked boundary marked.
Your inspection did not establish a fine outer-board route. The next watch uses the stone threshold until the keepers finish checking it.

finish.narration: The keeper closes the log before the pages can drink any more rain. Your party can rest, return to the lookout, or follow the griffin messenger down to the Cairnstep.

ready_lane_response_door.narration: The last keeper reaches the hall. Everyone is under the stone roof.

ready_lane_response_count.narration: The keeper confirms nobody is left outside. Everyone is under the stone roof.

ready_lane_response_cushion.narration: A cushion retires from duty as a very soft helmet. Everyone is under the stone roof.

watch_help_response_hold.narration: Nobody loads the line during the drill. The relief watch finishes its keeper-led practice.

watch_help_response_cloth.narration: The relief watch follows the keeper. The relief watch finishes its keeper-led practice.

watch_help_response_account.narration: The log credits the keeper-led demonstration. The relief watch finishes its keeper-led practice.
